wages.text: As a Palo Alto City Council member, Berman led an effort to raise the local minimum wage.
wages.quote: I led the effort to increase the minimum wage for struggling workers

housing.text: Berman says he has written bills to cut regulation and build more affordable housing across California.
housing.quote: I've written bills to reduce red tape and build more affordable housing

guns.text: Berman has authored firearm-related legislation, including a firearm violence prevention training program for physicians.
guns.quote: I've authored bills to establish a first-in-the-nation firearm violence prevention training program for physicians

abortion.text: Berman says he has fought to protect and expand abortion access and has a 100% Planned Parenthood record.
abortion.quote: I've fought to protect and expand the right to choose here in California, earning a lifetime 100% voting record from Planned Parenthood.

energy.text: Berman wrote California's first-in-the-nation law banning sales of gas-powered leaf blowers and lawnmowers to cut emissions.
energy.quote: I wrote the law to make California the first state in the nation to ban the sale of gas-powered leaf blowers and lawnmowers to reduce emissions of climate changing pollutants

voting.text: Berman wrote the law making California a permanent vote-by-mail state to expand ballot access.
voting.quote: he wrote the landmark law for California to be a permanent vote-by-mail state
